narrative.overview:
The platform site is Swiss type shot with the shutter open: periwinkle light, one coral creature, and the real app, moved by the scroll. It speaks in two registers that share one palette and one creature, and every page is built from three colour layers: the page ground, brand stages and product mockups.

The **studio register** carries the homepage (`/platform`) and Signals (`/platform/signals`). Both are getlayers templates re-purposed for Anarix. The homepage is "AI Studio": a gradient hero card with real app pieces floating in it, which tilts and closes onto the first card of a 3D ring of six products over a giant marquee; Aan's white diamond opening into a black world with a particle sphere and "AI for good"; pinned horizontal story panels; and app fragments drifting past a card that opens into the close. Signals is "Relay": black, a halo of light fibres behind everything, dark glass cards, mono labels, and the real Signals UI. Headlines here are Inter 500, larger in size than in weight; light comes from deep-blue-to-periwinkle gradients with a coral glow, from the three.js particle sphere and from the Signals halo. The homepage covers the whole platform (Signals, Profitability, Advertising, Rules, MCP, Ask Aan), never Aan alone.

The **screen register** carries the other product pages (Profitability, Rules, MCP with its pinned McpGap scene, and Aan). It is the Phase 8 system: one idea per `Screen`, Inter 800 headlines on a 12-column grid, long-exposure light trails converging on what matters, product UI on `ProductFrame` cards that turn toward the cursor, and one travelling, limbless Aan.

In both registers the proof is the product. On the homepage and Signals it is the app UI kit (`components/app-ui`): close recreations of single elements of the real Anarix app, in the app's own colours, following the theme the way the app does. Every number in it is labelled as sample data. Aan, the coral diamond from the Ask Aan island, is flat and matte everywhere; there is no glossy object on the site. Rejected and gone: soft clay (`ClayBlock`, the clay mascot shading, the clay CTA), the glossy three.js Aan, the City Nocturne line-art scenes and the soft isometric "circuit" drawings. None of them return.
keyCharacteristics: Three colour layers: the page ground follows the theme, brand stages stay one colour in both themes, product mockups follow the theme with the app's own tokens.

Two registers on one palette: studio (Inter 500, gradient cards, black worlds, pinned GSAP scenes) on the homepage and Signals; screen (Inter 800, `Screen`, `ProductFrame`, `LightTrails`, travelling Aan) on the other product pages.
The site's own hues are periwinkle (230) and coral (355); the app's green, red and amber appear only inside product mockups.
Real app elements, never whole pages, always labelled "Sample data" or "Illustrative".
Lenis smooth scroll under GSAP ScrollTrigger timelines that are pinned and scrubbed; transforms and opacity only while scrolling; the chrome reads its tone on a 90ms throttle, never per frame.
Aan is flat, matte and limbless everywhere.
IBM Plex Mono for indexes, clocks, figures and honest labels; Fraunces for written moments and for the single italic word in a Signals headline.

rules.name: The Three Layers Rule
rules.body: Every colour is ground, stage or mockup. The ground follows the theme; a brand stage keeps its colours in both themes; a mockup follows the theme through `--app-*` and never takes a stage's colours. Nothing on a stage reads `--ground`, and nothing on the ground is a fixed white or black.

rules.name: The No Green Rule
rules.body: The site's own type, chrome, gradients, trails and halo never use green: positive is periwinkle, negative is coral. Green enters only inside a product mockup, as the app's own `--app-gain` for gains and Done, beside the app's red (`--app-risk`) for risk and amber (`--app-warn`) for warnings. Outside `components/app-ui` no hue between roughly 60 and 180 appears.

rules.name: The Two Hues Rule
rules.body: Outside product mockups, only periwinkle (230) and coral (355) carry hue. A studio surface may blend from one to the other, and the blend's middle stops are the violets between them (`#c993d6`, `#6a5fe0`); a violet never appears on its own as a flat fill, a text colour or a UI state.

rules.name: The Coral Is Aan's Rule
rules.body: On the site's own surfaces coral is Aan, something going wrong, or the warm glow at the foot of a studio gradient. It is never a button fill, a heading, a link or a state of success.

rules.name: The One Risk Trail Rule
rules.body: A set of light trails is all periwinkle, except that a screen about a risk may run exactly one trail coral (`risk` index on `LightTrails`), and only while that risk is live.

rules.name: The Scope Rule
rules.body: In the screen register, colours come from the `.nocturne` roles (`--sky`, `--ink`, `--ink-2`, `--accent`, `--accent-solid`, `--risk`, `--risk-ink`, `--rule`, `--card`, `--card-line`, `--bubble-*`) and theme is the whole page at a different hour. In the studio register, ground, stage and mockup colours come from `--ground-*`, the stage's own fixed values and `--app-*`.

rules.name: The Weight Per Register Rule
rules.body: Screen-register headlines are Inter 800 between -0.04em and -0.055em, line-height under 1, fluid by both width and height (`min(vw, svh)`). Studio-register headlines are Inter 500 between -0.04em and -0.045em, line-height 1 to 1.08. Never mix the two weights in one section.

rules.name: The Grey Prose, Ink Phrase Rule
rules.body: Prose is the quieter ink; only the phrases that carry the argument switch to full ink at 500. In studio headlines the same move runs the other way: the second line drops to white at 50–60%. Emphasis is contrast, not colour or size.

rules.name: The Written Word Rule
rules.body: Fraunces is for writing that reads as written by someone (the morning brief, Aan's letter) and, in Signals only, for one italic word per headline. It never sets a whole headline, a figure or UI.

rules.name: The Mono Counts Rule
rules.body: Plex Mono sets numbers that count, time or order something, and the sample-data notes. Every figure that changes uses tabular numerals.

rules.name: The Em Scale Rule
rules.body: A mockup is sized by `--app-fs` and everything inside it in em; it is never scaled with a CSS or GSAP `scale` to fit. Motion may scale a piece in flight (the hero pieces flying into the centre card), never to size it.

rules.name: The One Viewport Rule
rules.body: Above 620px of height, a `fit="screen"` section and every pinned studio scene is exactly one viewport; cut copy or hide optional detail instead. QA is `scripts/qa/screens.mjs` at 1280x720, 1366x768, 1440x900, 1920x1080 and 390x844 with `fit-check.js`, in both themes (`--theme light|dark`, which seeds the saved theme before the page boots): a `Screen` is checked at its top, a `StoryScroll` at the middle of each chapter, and a GSAP-pinned `[data-pin]` scene at its start and at 36%, 68% and 98% through its pin-spacer. Flowing Relay sections on Signals are not screens and are not held to one viewport.

rules.name: The Pinned Scene Rule
rules.body: A long story is a pinned, scrubbed scene, and its number is set by the page's register: the homepage is three pinned scenes back to back, Signals has one, a screen-register page has at most one (`StoryScroll` or a GSAP pin, such as MCP's `McpGap`).

rules.name: The Ruled, Not Boxed Rule
rules.body: In the screen register, group with space first and a 1px Rule hairline second (`.c-points`, proof figures, the permission ladder). Only product UI, studio cards and panels, the hero proof strip, the start steps, the film and video frames are boxed, and nothing is a card inside a card except mockups inside a studio card or panel, which is the template's own device.

rules.name: The Light Is The Depth Rule
rules.body: Lift comes from light (trails, pools, floor glows, the cursor spotlight, the particle sphere, the halo, radial glows and auras) and from real perspective, never from a hover lift or a hard offset shadow. Every surface on the site is matte, Aan included; nothing gets a sheen, a clearcoat or a glossy gradient, and no glossy object returns.

rules.name: The No Clay Rule
rules.body: Soft clay is retired. Aan, the primary CTA and every block are flat: no lit top edges, core shadows, contact shadows or pressed-in labels.

rules.name: The Quiet Halo Rule
rules.body: On Signals the halo is sharp and bright only behind the hero. Every halo shape after it is defocused (0.9 or more) and dimmer (glow 0.42–0.55, no core), and a scroll-scrubbed scrim (`.scrim`, black radial at 30–72%) fades in over the canvas from 35% of the hero to its bottom, so the page reads. Under reduced motion the scrim sits at 0.85.

rules.name: The Smooth Scroll Rule
rules.body: Nothing re-renders React per scroll frame: scroll scenes write transforms and opacity through GSAP, the halo sets shader uniforms, the chrome tone reads at most every 90ms, and layout is measured on ScrollTrigger refresh only (`invalidateOnRefresh`, function-based values, the halo's `measure` on `refresh`). WebGL draws only while it can be seen (the sphere is switched by its ScrollTrigger, the halo stops when the tab is hidden). Reduced motion shows each scene's end state and leaves Lenis off.

rules.name: The Transform And Opacity Rule
rules.body: Animate transform and opacity. The exceptions the build carries are the blur-rise reveals, the trails' stroke draw, colour and glow transitions on hover and state, Aan's cube and bar morphs, the Intro's hero frame collapsing onto its centre card by `clip-path`, and the `data-tone` attribute sets; add no more.

rules.name: The Depth Drift Rule
rules.body: Parallax exists only inside the studio register, as depth: the hero's floating pieces lean with the pointer by their depth while the Intro is at rest, each gallery panel's mock drifts 10% each way against its frame, and the finale's fragments travel at speeds set by their depth. The screen register has none.

dos: **Do** put every colour in its layer: page ground from `--ground-*`, brand stages fixed in both themes, product mockups from `--app-*`.
**Do** keep periwinkle and coral as the site's only hues; let studio gradients blend between them, and leave the app's green, red and amber inside mockups.
**Do** declare `data-tone` on every studio section and set it from the timeline when a pinned scene changes what sits under the chrome.
**Do** take every screen-register colour from the `.nocturne` roles so night and day both work.

**Do** set screen-register headlines in Inter 800 (`.t-h2`, the name sizes) and studio headlines in Inter 500, and keep Fraunces for the morning brief, Aan's letter and one italic word per Signals headline.
**Do** build mockups from single app-ui elements, sized by `--app-fs`, with neutral sample names and a "Sample data" or "Illustrative" note.
**Do** give the homepage the whole platform (Signals, Profitability, Advertising, Rules, MCP, Ask Aan), never a page about Aan alone.
**Do** keep proof figures to $1.2B GMV, 500+ brands and 12.8% TACoS.
**Do** name marketplaces and apps (Amazon, Walmart, Shopify, Slack, Claude) as text.

**Do** build scroll scenes as pinned, scrubbed GSAP timelines over Lenis, moving transforms and opacity, measuring on refresh only, and mark them `data-pin` so `fit-check.js` checks them through the pin; run QA in both themes.
**Do** pause WebGL when it cannot be seen and load three.js only when the component mounts.
**Do** design the reduced-motion state on purpose: each scene's end state shown in flow, nothing travelling, no Lenis.
**Do** keep the nav, the Ask Aan island and the footer at parity with www.anarix.ai.
donts: **Don't** use green, teal or any hue outside periwinkle (230) and coral (355) on the site's own type, chrome, gradients, trails or halo, or a flat violet fill on its own.
**Don't** paint a brand stage with `--ground`, or let a mockup keep dark colours in the light theme.
**Don't** use coral for buttons, headings, links or success states.
**Don't** recreate a whole app page as a mockup, invent customers, or show an unlabelled number.
**Don't** scale a mockup with a transform to make it fit; change `--app-fs`.
**Don't** give Aan arms, legs, hands or a face beyond its two eyes, or restyle it outside the island's `AanMascot` and the ring card's white diamond.
**Don't** bring back soft clay, a glossy or clearcoated Aan, City Nocturne line-art scenes or the soft isometric drawings.
**Don't** set React state from scroll, animate layout properties while scrolling, measure the DOM on a scroll frame, or check the chrome tone per frame.
**Don't** invent testimonials, logos or prices, or draw marketplace or app logos.
**Don't** let a `fit="screen"` section or a pinned scene grow past one viewport above 620px of height.
**Don't** add hover lifts, hard offset shadows, glossy surfaces or gradient text.
**Don't** add parallax outside the studio register, or a second pinned story to a screen-register page.
**Don't** bring the film's stamp red, Bodoni or grain onto site pages.
